description: This bar chart, titled “NDCG@10,” displays the performance of four different methods on the INSPIRED dataset, with the vertical axis representing the NDCG@10 score ranging from 0.05 to 0.25 in increments of 0.05, and the horizontal axis listing the four methods: “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking.” The “Ours” method, represented by an orange bar, achieves the highest score at approximately 0.21. The “- critiquing” method, shown as a blue bar, achieves a score of approximately 0.19. The “- scoring” method, also a blue bar, has the lowest score at approximately 0.07. The “- ranking” method, another blue bar, achieves a score of approximately 0.12. The bars are arranged in a single group along the horizontal axis, with no explicit sorting, and all bars are solid-colored with no visual emphasis or annotations.
